speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a penny. It is a full thumb short of the notch. I am not measuring it, and I am not pricing your sitting again. I said that on Monday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday will do for the price. Three bites. I am out at two, and I am not bringing a plot down.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The clove is the one you have. I have not been to a shop, and I am not starting today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not start. The jaw is the jaw. I will speak on the side that answers, and I will be home when the gown is off.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat. If you mean a barber, you may mean him on another day. I am not sending for one between a loaf and a trumpet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not mean one. The jaw can wait. Today the king is this afternoon's, and he has no name I am giving this table.
